E0154

A protocol line does not name `client:` or `server:` as its sender.

What

A protocol line does not name `client:` or `server:` as its sender.

Why

A two-endpoint protocol needs only the sender. The other endpoint is the receiver, so a transport arrow repeats information.

Fix

Write `client: Message(…)` when the client sends, or `server: Message(…)` when the server sends.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0154: tests/ui/protocol_bad_endpoint.stderr.

Error [E0154]: expected receiver `server`, found `client`
  --> tests/ui/protocol_bad_endpoint.jet:4:15
    |
  4 |     client -> client: Oops(version: Int)
    |               ^^^^^^
 Why: the retired endpoint-pair spelling still had to name the opposite endpoint
 Fix: write `client: …`
